edouard-claude-ironloop-engineering-iron.description: Verification-first software engineering harness with 5 layers (spec → gen → test → sim → pentest). Use when generating, reviewing, or planning code with AI agents, especially for Rust projects, new feature work, legacy migrations, or any task where code correctness must be guaranteed. Activates on phrases like "build a", "implement", "refactor", "review this code", "migrate from", "add tests for", or when the user describes a coding task with correctness or security requirements.
